verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say the platform can "Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically," so it has a first-party questionnaire capability. Nothing in the pack shows how questionnaires get in or out, or that they are returned in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet/portal questionnaires, export back in the customer's original format, portal integrations, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
